title: Ya Mustafa
body:
Ya Mustafa
Ya Mustafa..(4)
tujhko pukare har zaba'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Mohammad mustafa
<<MINI>>
Badr-ud-duja, shams-uz-zuha, khair-ul-wara, Ya Mustafa
Ya mustafa...
Badr-ud-duja, shams-uz-zuha, khair-ul-wara, Ya Mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaya zamee'n pe to qur'aan laya
duniya pe rahmat ban kar chhaya
duniya ko tune deen sikhaya
rang o zaba'n ka fark mitaya
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
<<DIVIDER>>
To khe khuda mehbub banayo
saare jaha'n teya tohenjo saayo
bande khe tu khaliq sa milayo
noor sa tu aalam chamkayo
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Jad wi nawa tera sohna naawa
rabb de lakh lakh shukr manawa
kar de karam tere roze te aawa
dar te tere muk jawan saawa
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
<<DIVIDER>>
ta be saharo ta sahara ye
ta aajizano ta mojiza ye
ta mo'mina no mushkil kusha ye
ta musalmano hajat rawa ye
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya rasoolallah tayi azmat
ya nabi tayi shano shaukat
duniya e wasta raaye jannat
har chi na manni ruwa dozakh
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya mustafa stot kha yari byala
thob na michoq po stongsa nayala
goqse shukur yang schos pi khudala
dena salam yang rchoks po khujala
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ba labe muslim isme mustafa ast
misle shuma az jahan kuja ast
noor e shuma az jahaan dar jahaan
khilqat e alam baraye shuma ast
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Anta za'eem e jamee'al ambiya
anta habeeballah ya mustafa
wa anta noorullah ya mujtaba
anta muzammil wa anta taaha
<<MINI>>
tujhko pukare har zaba'n..
author: Farhan Ali
